storyCards.headline: Lil' Devil: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The Cult's "Lil' Devil" — original release 2022. Electric is the third album by British rock band the Cult, released in 1987.

Artist: The Cult · Title: Lil' Devil · Album: Lil' Devil · Year: 1987 · Genre: Rock · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1980's/The Cult - Lil' Devil.mp4.

It was the follow-up to their commercial breakthrough Love.

The album equalled its predecessor's chart placing by peaking at number four in the UK but exceeded its chart residency, spending a total of 27 weeks on the chart (the most successful run for an album by The Cult).
